notes: All 12 views inspected. Flywheel with a machined clutch face, a bolt-circle of six dowel holes, a central pilot bore, a ring gear with individually cut starter teeth around the full circumference, and dowel pins on the reverse. Both faces are modelled and different, and the ring-gear teeth are real geometry visible in the edge-on views. The disc is a SEPARATE `_rotor` node, so a spin clip can be authored.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
Tooth count and bolt pattern are illustrative rather than matched to a real engine.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
